description: Check whether AI agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and more) can reach and read a website: robots.txt rules per agent, firewall blocking, content without JavaScript, structured data. Returns a 0-100 score, the problems found, and how to fix them. The result is also saved as a public report link.
name: check_website

kind.description: live: fetches pages for a user; search: AI search index; train: AI training

liveVerdict.description: Result of a request sent with this agent name; absent when not tested

fix.description: How to fix it; empty when there is nothing to fix

complete.description: False when the site blocked even a normal browser request; the score is then not meaningful

rules.description: Version of the checks; raised when checks or agents change

url.description: Page that was checked, after redirects

title: Check a website for AI agents
